svg.title: k-means: bad centers give long lines and large J, good centers give short lines and small J
svg.desc: Two scatter panels with the same 15 points. In the left panel the three centers are badly placed so lines are long. In the right panel the centers sit in the middle of each group so lines are short.
svg.text: line = distance ‖xᵢ − μₖ‖ (rᵢₖ picks which center)
J = sum of all squared line lengths
k-means moves the centers to make J as small as possible.
